rule_metadata: CodeQL py/sql-injection: untrusted user input flows to a SQL query sink.

llm.prompt_extra: Context: the scanner is the CodeQL query py/sql-injection, a data-flow query. It reports user input that flows through the program to the argument of a database execute call. A verdict of clean means the query no longer reports a finding. A candidate is built by adding one operator at a time, and an operator can be added only if it comes later than the last one added in this fixed order: rename, format_swap, literal_slice, dead_padding, extract_1, branch_split, dict_dispatch, char_launder, queue_roundtrip. When no operator is available the search restarts from the original program.
